name: Ritu Mahipal / रितु महिपाल

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ritu Mahipal’s poems in Kabita Live return to love, separation and the ties between generations. Her Hindi verses often speak directly to an absent beloved, bringing longing close to prayer. In “बचपन की याद”, a mother preparing for her daughter’s departure remembers her own childhood and the tenderness of her mother’s care.

“न शिकायत है, न शिकवा है।” gives voice to a soldier’s wife, holding pride and grief together through a recurring reminder of promises left unfulfilled. The English piece “I have seen love turning into hatred,” uses a series of reversals—between joy and sorrow, huts and palaces, toys and paper boats—to question where happiness is found.
